# CodetoKloud

> CodetoKloud is a US registered IT consulting company and AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner headquartered in Naperville, Illinois. The company designs, migrates, secures, and operates AWS cloud infrastructure for clients across the United States.

Canonical website: https://codetokloud.com/

## Core services

- [AWS architecture and cloud infrastructure](https://codetokloud.com/cloud-service): AWS landing zones, networking, data services, backups, and scalable production infrastructure.
- [DevOps and CI/CD consulting](https://codetokloud.com/devops): Delivery automation, Terraform, GitOps, release workflows, and operational reliability.
- [Kubernetes and Amazon EKS consulting](https://codetokloud.com/kubernetes): EKS architecture, migration, Helm, ArgoCD, autoscaling, observability, security, and cost controls.
- [AWS cloud migration](https://codetokloud.com/cloud-migration): Assessment, migration planning, replatforming, and tested cutover to AWS.
- [FinOps and AWS cost optimization](https://codetokloud.com/finops): Cost visibility, allocation, rightsizing, commitment planning, and cost-aware architecture.
- [Security and compliance engineering](https://codetokloud.com/security-and-compliance): Technical controls and evidence for SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS programs.
- [AI workflows on AWS](https://codetokloud.com/ai): Secure AI applications and workflow automation built around defined business use cases.

## Industries served

- [SaaS and ISV](https://codetokloud.com/saas-isv)
- [Healthcare](https://codetokloud.com/healthcare)

- [Private equity and venture capital](https://codetokloud.com/pe-vc)
- [Small and mid-size businesses](https://codetokloud.com/small-and-mid-size-business)

## Selected case studies

- [Case study library](https://codetokloud.com/case-studies): AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, security, compliance, and hybrid infrastructure engagements with project-specific outcomes.
- [Healthcare Kubernetes migration on Amazon EKS](https://codetokloud.com/goagalia-healthcare-workforce-management): A healthcare workforce platform migration with technical safeguards for regulated workloads, approximately 35 percent lower cost, API latency reduced from 850 ms to 320 ms, and 99.7 percent uptime.
- [SOC 2 healthcare platform on AWS](https://codetokloud.com/soc-2-healthcare-aws-case-study): A Multi-AZ AWS platform with audit logging, encryption, and 99.99 percent uptime.
- [Hybrid cloud Kubernetes](https://codetokloud.com/hybrid-cloud-kubernetes-case-study): A Kubernetes platform connecting on-premises hardware and cloud burst capacity through encrypted inter-site connectivity over WireGuard.
- [PCI DSS-aligned Cloud Workstations](https://codetokloud.com/pci-dss-enterprise-case-study): A PCI DSS-aligned Cloud Workstations design with hardened Ubuntu images, private networking, Shielded VMs, CMEK, Terraform modules, and documentation to support QSA review.
- [Multi-brand AWS Fargate modernization](https://codetokloud.com/multi-brand-aws-fargate-modernization-case-study): Four brands standardized on Amazon ECS Fargate, Aurora MySQL, AWS Amplify, and repeatable delivery, with a database issue resolved without downtime.
- [EKS microservices delivery with GitOps](https://codetokloud.com/eks-gitops-microservices-case-study): Containerized services delivered through Amazon EKS, GitHub Actions, Helm, and ArgoCD, with secrets kept out of Git and controlled production promotion.
- [CIS Kubernetes Benchmark assessment](https://codetokloud.com/cis-kubernetes-benchmark-assessment-case-study): Amazon EKS and Linode LKE assessed control by control, with managed service responsibilities mapped.

## AI and DevOps guides

- [How AI is changing DevOps](https://codetokloud.com/blogs/how-ai-is-changing-devops): What increased after AI entered delivery workflows, where it helps, which risks require controls, and how to evaluate results with delivery and reliability metrics.
- [AI-generated Terraform and Kubernetes review checklist](https://codetokloud.com/blogs/ai-generated-infrastructure-as-code-review-checklist): A review path covering deterministic validation, dependencies, secrets, policy checks, plan review, approval, progressive delivery, and recovery.
- [AI for cloud and Kubernetes incident response](https://codetokloud.com/blogs/ai-incident-response-cloud-kubernetes): A safe operating model for evidence gathering, hypothesis testing, autonomy tiers, bounded remediation, approval, and incident evaluation.
- [Securing AI coding agents in CI/CD](https://codetokloud.com/blogs/securing-ai-coding-agents-ci-cd): Identity, permissions, runner isolation, prompt injection defenses, security checks, protected pull requests, production gates, and kill switches.
